model_output.verdict: A customer success manager with a defined account book and a few questions about renewals and escalations.
write_up: Your resume tells a clear customer success story: you moved from support into managing mid-market payroll accounts at Brightline. A recruiter can see the customers and work you handle, though your part in renewal strategy and payroll escalations needs more detail.

The onboarding checklist is a strong model: you built something the whole CS team now uses, so its reach is easy to understand. Your experience leads the resume, and the progression at Brightline is easy to follow.
Start with the renewal strategy line. Add what you contributed and what happened to the accounts, if you can confirm it. Then give the same treatment to the payroll escalations.

cards.line: - Partnered with Sales on renewal strategy for at-risk accounts
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter can't tell what you contributed to the renewal strategy or what happened to the accounts. That matters for a role that follows customers through renewal.
cards.example: Partnered with Sales on renewal strategy for at-risk accounts by [your contribution], with [renewal result]
cards.question: What did you contribute to the strategy, and what happened to those accounts?

cards.line: - Built an onboarding checklist now used by the whole CS team
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. It names what you made and who uses it, without making a recruiter guess what your contribution was.

cards.line: - Handle escalations with Support and Product when payroll runs fail
cards.cannot_tell: The payroll problem and partners are clear, but 'handle' leaves your actions open to interpretation. What do you do when a run fails?
cards.example: Handle escalations with Support and Product when payroll runs fail by [actions taken], with [result]
cards.question: What do you do during a payroll escalation, and what happens after your work?

fit.why: Your headline and current role both point to customer success, with an account book, business reviews and renewal work.
fit.note: Your experience points toward customer success roles serving business software customers. The move from payroll support into account management gives you relevant customer-facing work across both roles.
